content:
Updated manifests fix the field path, align the XRD schema, add an explicit RDS readiness check, and use Resources composition mode because the composition uses `spec.resources`.

### `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: aws-web-service
  labels:
    crossplane.io/xrd: xawswebservices.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com
  mode: Resources
  resources:
    - name: rds-instance
      base:
        apiVersion: database.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
        kind: Instance
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-east-1
            engine: postgres
            engineVersion: "16.1"
            allocatedStorage: 20
            backupRetentionPeriod: 7
            deletionProtection: true
            publiclyAccessible: false
          providerConfigRef:
            name: default

      patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.instanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass

        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.deletionProtection
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection

      readinessChecks:
        - type: MatchCondition
          matchCondition:
            type: Ready
            status: "True"
```

### `xrd.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xawswebservices.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com

  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                      description: RDS instance class.
                      default: db.t3.medium
                      enum:
                        - db.t3.micro
                        - db.t3.medium
                    deletionProtection:
                      type: boolean
                      description: Enables RDS deletion protection.
                      default: true
                  required:
                    - instanceClass
              required:
                - parameters

  claimNames:
    kind: AWSWebService
    plural: awswebservices
```

The important readiness behavior is:

```yaml
readinessChecks:
  - type: MatchCondition
    matchCondition:
      type: Ready
      status: "True"
```

This causes the composed RDS resource to be considered ready only after its managed-resource `Ready=True` condition is reported.
